summary: PASS (sound), no high/critical. OIDC least privilege correct, no secret-exfil or injection surface, provenance/repo alignment verified. review.finding: No guard that the pushed tag matches bootstrapper/package.json version; publishes package.json's version regardless of tag name.
review.resolution: APPLIED - added a 'Verify tag matches package version' fail-fast step before build asserting v${package.json.version} == ${GITHUB_REF_NAME}.

review.finding: npm install -g npm@latest floats the release-critical toolchain.
review.resolution: APPLIED - pinned to npm@^11.5.1 (known-good OIDC floor).

review.finding: id-token:write was workflow-scoped; future jobs would inherit OIDC minting.
review.resolution: APPLIED - moved permissions under jobs.publish (job-scoped least privilege).

review.finding: No concurrency guard; two rapid tag pushes launch overlapping publish runs.
review.resolution: APPLIED - added concurrency group publish-npm-${{ github.ref }}.
